about: Combat feel flipbooks (Docs/Story.md "The feel of a hit", Dead Cells-style). Twelve one-shot bursts packed into Resources/Effects/FeelVfxAtlas. Gen: image.generate keyframe on #00ff00 → video.i2v → sprite.sheet (key 00ff00, 10 frames, 256 px cells); pack rows top-to-bottom in Kind enum order at 128 px.
name: FeelVfxAtlas
